title: Can MLLMs Read the Room? A Multimodal Benchmark for Assessing Deception in Multi-Party Social Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2511.16221v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite their advanced reasoning capabilities, state-of-the-art Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) still lack a core component of human intelligence: the ability to "read the room" and assess deception in complex social interactions. To rigorously evaluate this limitation, we introduce Multimodal Interactive Deception Assessment (MIDA), a new task and multimodal dataset comprising synchronized video and text with verifiable ground-truth labels for every statement. We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source MLLMs and identify a substantial performance gap: even powerful models such as GPT-4o struggle to reliably distinguish truthful statements from deceptive ones. Our analysis shows that current models have difficulty grounding language in multimodal social cues and modeling what others know, believe, or intend. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型能“察言观色”吗？一个用于评估多方社交互动中欺骗行为的多模态基准
translated_abstract: 尽管具备先进的推理能力，最先进的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）仍然缺乏人类智能的一个核心组成部分：在复杂社交互动中“察言观色”并识别欺骗行为的能力。为了严格评估这一局限，我们提出了多模态交互式欺骗评估任务，这是一个全新的任务和多模态数据集，包含同步的视频与文本，并为每条陈述提供可验证的真实标签。我们对12个最先进的开源与闭源MLLMs进行了基准测试，发现存在显著的性能差距：即使是GPT-4o这样强大的模型也难以可靠地区分真实陈述与欺骗性陈述。我们的分析表明，当前模型难以将语言与多模态社交线索相关联，也难以建模他人所知、所信或所想的意图。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了社会思维链推理管线等
tldr: 该论文提出多模态交互式欺骗评估基准MIDA，揭示包括GPT-4o在内的当前多模态大语言模型在多方社交互动中难以识别欺骗行为，并进一步提出社会思维链推理管线SoCoT以增强模型基于多模态社交线索进行欺骗评估的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MIDA, a multimodal benchmark with verifiable ground-truth labels for assessing deception in multi-party social interactions, revealing that state-of-the-art MLLMs (including GPT-4o) struggle to reliably distinguish truth from deception, and proposes a Social Chain-of-Thought (SoCoT) reasoning pipeline to improve models' grounding in multimodal social cues.
